newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT, RUHBY UNION - Brain to lead NZ Maori rugby squad.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT, RUHBY UNION - Brain to lead NZ Maori rugby squad.

text.p: Counties-Manukau captain and No. 8 Errol Brain will lead a 26-strong New Zealand Maori squad on their three-match tour of Fiji and Tonga beginning later this month.
The Maori team will play Fiji at Suva on November 1 before taking on the Tongan Barbarians in Nuku'alofa on November 5 and then Tonga on November 8, NZPA reported.
The latter two matches will be evening kickoffs.
Coach Matt Te Pou's squad contains several current and former All Blacks as well as some promising youngsters.

Among the senior members are All Blacks prop Phil Coffin, hooker Norm Hewitt and winger Eric Rush, along with Auckland fullback Adrian Cashmore, who had been selected to tour South Africa before succumbing to injury.
Former All Blacks Mark Cooksley, Dallas Seymour and Stu Forster are also in the Maori squad.
Due to injury Danny Love and Aaron Hopa were not available for selection.

The full squad is: Norman Berryman (Northland), Errol Brain (captain, Counties-Manukau), Tony Brown (Otago), Adrian Cashmore (Auckland), Jim Coe (Counties-Manukau), Phil Coffin (King Country), Mark Cooksley (Waikato), Jarrod Cunningham (Hawke's Bay), Rhys Duggan (Waikato), Stu Forster (Otago), Milton Going (Northland), Norm Hewitt (Southland), Lee Lidgard (Counties-Manukau), Mark Mayerhofler (Canterbury), Slade McFarland (North Harbour), Dion Muir (Waikato), Kevin Nepia (Auckland), Mutu Ngarimu (Poverty Bay), Nathan Paewai (Hawke's Bay), Caleb Ralph (Bay of Plenty), Roger Randle (Hawke's Bay), Eric Rush (North Harbour), Dallas Seymour (Hawke's Bay), Matthew
Te Pou (Thames Valley), Paul Thomson (Auckland), Dion Waller (King Country).
